correctness.rationale: Theorem 5.16 of arXiv:2610.05311v1 supplies an iff criterion on six vertices. Exhausting all \(2^{20}\) masks gives 50,334 tetrahedron-condition hypergraphs; the published obstruction has a directly computed \(S_6\) orbit of size 120; subtraction gives 50,214. Exact face counts and a direct orbit partition are asserted by the supplied verifier, whose 174 orbits match Remark 5.17. No finite experiment is used to prove the external classification theorem.

value.rationale: The six-vertex case is the minimal setting highlighted by the new paper where the local tetrahedron condition needs an exceptional global obstruction. The labeled census measures realizable incidence patterns for the six generators, the face enumerator records the number of coordinate 2-planes in the point scheme, and the orbit profile explains how the published 174 isomorphism classes expand to labeled configurations. These are natural exact invariants of the newly resolved boundary case rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
